title: Personalizing Ad Load to Optimize Subscription and Ad Revenues: Product Strategies Constructed from Experiments on Pandora
authors: Ali Goli; David Reiley; Hongkai Zhang
eligible_reason: Not a staggered DiD. Randomized field experiment on Pandora with a common start date: listeners are randomized to ad-load conditions. Main estimates are IV regressions of outcomes on realized ad load instrumented by treatment group (05.IV_regs.R), HTE via ML (07/08 notebooks), and IPW counterfactual panels (11.CounterFactualPanel.R). The package ships only synthetic data.
design_notes: R (lfe::felm) and Python notebooks. 05.IV_regs.R: felm(outcome ~ 1 | 0 | (realizedAdload ~ tg)) week by week; 09.HTE_Figures.R: felm(sub ~ treatment:as.factor(lift_quintile)). No unit-specific adoption dates.

specs.exclusion_reason: IV regressions in a randomized experiment with a common start date; continuous treatment (realized ad load)
cross-sectional treatment-by-predicted-lift-quintile regression in an RCT

data_files_note: ReadMe: original Pandora/SiriusXM data cannot be shared; the package simulates synthetic data (01.simulateData.R, 02.simulatePanelData.R).
data_provenance_note: Synthetic data generated by the authors' simulation scripts.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text or PDF). RCT with IV; synthetic data. Ineligible on design and data.
